description: The billionaire stadium owner who allegedly led efforts to remove Macklemore as Ed Sheeran’s opening act over his pro-Palestinian comments onstage is now donating $2 million US in aid to "the region."
title: Ed Sheeran reportedly donating $2M to 'aid in the region' amid Macklemore fallout

author: Jennifer Yoon
description: The federal government is investing $150 million in LawZero, a Montreal-based non-profit working to build a new kind of AI model. Germany is providing an additional 100 million euros. The funding comes amid new, high-profile warnings from AI leaders about existential risks from cutting-edge models.
title: Canada is investing $150M to make AI safer. Will it work?

author: Murray Brewster
description: Canada has formally applied to join the United Kingdom's Joint Expeditionary Force, reversing a decision made more than a decade ago. Born from the Afghanistan war and reshaped by Russia's invasion of Ukraine, the coalition promises speed and flexibility — but raises an old question about what Canada is actually committing itself to.
title: Canada wants into Britain's rapid-response defence club

author: David Cummings
description: Diana Fox Carney — Prime Minister Mark Carney's wife — is stepping into an unpaid role focused on ocean conservation, including chairing an international conference set to take place in Halifax next year.
title: Diana Fox Carney appointed as Canada's ocean envoy, chair of Our Ocean Conference

author: Emma Loop
description: Traffic at the new Gordie Howe International Bridge connecting Windsor, Ont., and Detroit topped 340,000 in its first full month of operation, according to new data.
title: Gordie Howe bridge vehicle traffic tops 340,000 in first full month of operation

description: U.S. President ‌Donald Trump ​signed a presidential ​memorandum on ​Wednesday to identify Canadian-origin goods ‌in federal civil government procurement ‌and take steps ​to remove them, the White House ​said.
title: Trump signs memorandum to identify and remove Canadian products from U.S. federal procurement

author: Crystal Goomansingh
description: The documentary film NAZA is stirring outrage in Israel, prompting many to defend their military's actions in Gaza against accusations it approves strikes regardless of harm to Palestinian civilians, while the filmmakers question why critical reflection is being stonewalled.
title: Documentary alleges Israel bombs Gaza regardless of risk to civilians

author: Kayla McLean
description: Drake fans were treated to a little bit of everything — including several new tracks — when the rapper dropped his much anticipated "not so short film" on Tuesday night.
title: Drake's FOMO film takes fans on a Toronto-filled summer ride, featuring new music and Iron Man suits

author: Emily Chung
description: Scientists have long discussed whether and which dinosaurs were warm-blooded. Now, researchers say they have used chemistry to take the temperature of two T. rexes. Here's what they found.
title: How do you take T. rex's temperature? These scientists did it

description: U.S. Representative Gregory Meeks, the top Democrat on the House of ‌Representatives Foreign Affairs Committee, said on Wednesday he would ​not support the ​sale of 2,000-pound bombs to Israel over concerns ​the munitions would not be used in ‌accordance with international law.
title: Top Dem on foreign affairs committee opposes Trump-proposed $2.8B arms sale to Israel

description: Fencing went up Wednesday around the main Kennedy Center building, a day after the Trump-aligned board voted to close most of the performing arts centre for repairs.
title: Fencing goes up around Kennedy Center as activists worry it will be demolished

description: A diver was transported to hospital after being injured by a great white shark in Percé, Que., in the province’s Gaspé region.
title: Diver injured in great white shark attack off Quebec's Gaspé coast

description: The Federal Reserve said it cut rates to help bring inflation back to the central bank's two per cent target. It's the first policy shift under the new Fed chief, who took office in late May after being selected by Trump with an expectation that he would ‌cut rates. But economists say those pressures aren't hitting Canada in quite the same way, and don't put the same kind of pressure on the Bank of Canada.
title: U.S. Federal Reserve raises interest rates for 1st time in 3 years

author: Camilla Faragalli
description: Some George Gordon First Nation members are questioning the long-term implications of Bell's AI data centre expansion near Regina.
title: Bell's Sask. AI data centre expansion raises hopes, concerns for George Gordon First Nation members
'Read between the lines': Ford nearly endorses Olivia Chow for Toronto mayor

author: John Mazerolle
description: Countries including Syria, France and Guatemala have seen blockades, marches or other protests due to rising fuel prices caused by conflict in the Middle East.
title: Sky-high crude and diesel prices are fuelling protests worldwide

description: Russian drones struck a passenger bus and a train in southern Ukraine on Wednesday, killing five people, Ukrainian officials said, as Moscow pressed on with strikes on transport links and infrastructure. Russian President Vladimir Putin framed participation in an upcoming parliamentary election as a barometer of support for Russia's war in Ukraine and urged Russians to vote.
title: Russian drones hit bus, train in Ukraine, killing 5: officials

author: Francis Tessier-Burns
description: The website WE NEWS has three northern Indigenous 'AI correspondents.' Their profiles say they are 'a member of Yukon First Nation,' 'of Dene heritage,' and 'an Inuk raised in the North.' Experts in the industry call the site disturbing and say it muddies the waters for readers trying to get authentic information.
title: ‘Very harmful’: website uses AI to generate northern Indigenous news ‘correspondents’

author: Darrell Roberts
description: After several trial delays, former housing advocate Michelle Voisey is headed back to prison after pleading guilty to fraud.
title: St. John's woman with 160 prior convictions, including for fraud and forgery, gets jail time in CERB case

author: Cassandra Yanez-Leyton
description: A Quebec judge has ordered Élections Québec to prepare voter information cards in both English and in French, in a civil court judgment issued Wednesday morning.
title: Judge orders Élections Québec to prepare voter reminder cards in French and English

author: Jim Bronskill
description: Five gun control advocacy groups are renewing pressure on the RCMP to disclose information about the firearms used in the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., saying public discussion of the details could help prevent another tragedy.
title: Gun control advocacy groups push for details on weapon used in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., school shooting

description: Saudi warplanes pounded Yemen, the Houthis said on Wednesday, as the Iran-backed fighters solidified their gains after a lightning advance that has extended Tehran's reach in the Middle East war and further disrupted global oil supplies.
title: Saudis pound Yemen as Houthis solidify gains in new Middle East war front

author: Andrea Huncar
description: In an email, Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada said Halima Abdi’s application for permanent residence on humanitarian and compassionate grounds passed eligibility requirements on Sept. 9.
title: Federal authorities cancel Edmonton mom's removal from Canada hours before she boards plane

description: Strathcona County RCMP say a Cessna 172 touched down on Highway 21 with two people on board.
title: Small plane makes emergency landing on highway east of Edmonton

description: A European Union-backed court on Wednesday convicted former Kosovo president Hashim Thaçi of four counts of war crimes committed during his country's war for independence from Serbia and sentenced him to 25 years in prison.
title: Former Kosovo president Hashim Thaçi sentenced to 25 years for 1990s war crimes

author: Myles Dichter
description: In a landmark announcement, the federal government injected $76 million into a new national basketball facility, topped up by $24 million from the province of Ontario to reach an even $100 million in funding.
title: Canadian basketball scores new state-of-the-art facility with $100-million federal backing

author: Morgan Lowrie
description: Coalition Avenir Québec Leader Christine Fréchette was the main target in the first debate of the provincial election campaign on Tuesday as the five main party leaders sparred over the economy, Quebec sovereignty and immigration.
title: Christine Fréchette on the defensive over CAQ record during Quebec debate

description: A building housing half a dozen families gave out in Gaza City overnight into Wednesday, killing 19 people as they slept and leaving rescuers digging through rubble for dozens more who had been sheltering inside the structure.
title: At least 19 killed, including children, as unstable Gaza building collapses

description: Donald Trump has removed temporary protective status for Haitians in the U.S., his latest move in a years-long offensive against the community. Today, we unpack the American fascination with Haiti, to better understand Trump's focus on the Caribbean nation.
title: Why is Trump so focused on Haiti?

author: Sara Jabakhanji
description: Four years after the death of a young woman whose name became synonymous with the fight for women's rights and freedom in Iran, Amnesty International says the resulting government crackdown was a systemic campaign whose perpetrators continue to evade accountability.
title: Amnesty report says Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity in bloody 2022 protest crackdown

author: Ethan Hunt
description: Long before three Stanley Cups, an Olympic gold medal and the second-most wins by a goalie in NHL history, Marc-André Fleury moved to Cape Breton when he was 15. He didn’t speak a lick of English and had never heard of the Nova Scotia island.
title: Cape Breton billet family to share in Marc-André Fleury's QMJHL hall induction

description: A local NBC news helicopter crashed in a Los Angeles neighbourhood on Tuesday and burst into flames, killing at least three people while reporters were covering the nearby crash of an SUV and a city bus, officials and the station said.
title: 3 people killed when NBC news helicopter crashes while covering Los Angeles bus accident

description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Wednesday proposed opening a path for Canada to become the European Union's first associate member, a striking overture as U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs drive Ottawa closer to Europe.
title: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen says she wants Canada to become the bloc's 1st associate member

author: Ryan Cooke
description: A man abused by a notorious Catholic priest is joining others in calling on the church to release its records related to a controversial therapy centre in Ontario, where abusive priests were sent for decades. His abuser was sent there in 1992, and returned to work for nearly 20 years.
title: Man abused by notorious N.L. Catholic priest as a child calls on church to release treatment records of abusive priests
Is Donald 'drill, baby, drill' Trump helping the world transition away from oil?

author: Rachel Watts
description: Nunavik’s travelling court — which services several of the fly-in only northern communities on rotation — cancelled in-person fall dates in both Inukjuak and Puvirnituq, primarily due to the lack of necessary accommodation for those involved in the cases. Advocates argue it’s impacting people’s right to be tried in a reasonable time.
title: Cases stuck in limbo, detainees pleading guilty over justice system delays in northern Quebec

author: Georgie Smyth
description: The U.S. may be trade-warring with Canada but it's deepening its military ties with an ally Down Under. Australia's government says that in China, it's facing "the biggest conventional military buildup by any country in the world since the Second World War," and it wants America's help.
title: G'day, USA: Why is the U.S. accelerating military ties with Australia?

author: Nick Logan
description: New research published Wednesday in The American Journal of Preventive Medicine, found a nearly 100 per cent increase in emergency department visits, in just the past few years, following the rapid growth of privatized online gambling and legalization of betting on single sports events.
title: More people are seeking emergency care for gambling, a new study says — and it's mostly men and boys

author: Paul Forsyth
description: Their high school days might be in the rearview mirror, but residents of four long-term care homes in Ontario's Niagara region got to feel as if they were fresh-faced teenagers again, at a prom for seniors held in collaboration with Brock University students.
title: 'Nobody wanted it to end': Seniors prom brings together long-term care residents, Brock University students

author: Diona Macalinga
description: Roommates living in Foundry Lofts, a student residence in Thorold, Ont., say they were charged $1,600 for one month of utilities in June, with their bill showing 361,000 litres of water usage. But they say no one was living there at that time.
title: Roommates in Ont. student housing complex left with no explanation for $1.6k utility bill for a month their unit was vacant

author: Emily Chung
description: Canada's last epishelf lake — made up of freshwater floating on saltwater — is gone, along with the unique ecosystem it supported, scientists confirm. Here's what made the lake special, and what it disappearance says about the transformation of the Arctic in a warming climate.
title: This was the last lake of its kind in Canada. Now it's gone.

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: Stephen Colbert makes his late-night return on Jimmy Kimmel Live!, where he celebrates his Emmy win, shaves his beard and discusses life after The Late Show.
title: Stephen Colbert returns to late-night TV post-cancellation, as guest on Kimmel
